title: NeuroFlow Extension: neuroflow/usage
description: Schema for the neuroflow/usage extension namespace (RFC 0011). Advisory guidance for agents choosing, calling and recovering from a tool or workflow: when to use it and when not, preconditions, effects, typical duration, example calls, and failure remedies. Every field is optional, and a runtime MUST NOT change validation, planning or execution because of this block. Example inputs are checked against the document's declared inputs by an extension-aware validator, which this schema cannot express.

useWhen.description: Situations where this operation is the right choice, one sentence each.

avoidWhen.description: Situations where this operation is not the right choice, each with an optional alternative.

instead.description: The id of a tool or workflow document to use instead. A validator warns, and does not reject, when it does not resolve.

preconditions.description: What must hold before a run that the input types do not express.

effects.description: What a run does besides producing its declared outputs. Complements, and does not replace, the MCP annotation hints.

duration.description: The author's estimate of run time.

basis.description: The input the estimate was measured on. No identifiable data.

examples.description: Illustrative calls. A runtime MUST NOT run them unprompted.

inputs.description: Input id to example value. Keys must be declared inputs and values must fit their types; file values should be <name> placeholders or relative paths.

outputs.description: An abbreviated example result, output id to value.

failures.description: Known failures, checked in order; the first match supplies the remedy.

match.description: When both fields are given, both must match.

contains.description: A plain, case-sensitive substring of the error message or captured stderr tail. Not a pattern.

retry.description: never: retrying cannot help; after-fix: retry once the remedy is applied; safe: retrying as is may succeed.
